instructions: Answer these questions about your hobbies and how you spend your free time.
notes:
In my free time, I usually listen to V-pop music, scroll through TikTok, or play badminton with my neighbors to unwind after stressful classes. Honestly, high school students in Vietnam are quite overwhelmed with school schedules and extra classes, so my spare time is pretty limited. When I do have a moment to breathe, I prefer doing light activities that help me recharge my energy.

Currently, I am not a member of any official clubs or societies because my top priority is preparing for the grueling National High School Graduation Exam. My school does have English and sports clubs, but joining them requires a fixed time commitment that I cannot afford right now. Instead, I choose to participate in short-term volunteer activities organized by the Ho Chi Minh Communist Youth Union at my school when my timetable allows.

It really depends on my mood, but most of the time, I prefer spending my free time with other people. Going to a local coffee shop to study and chat with my close friends, or playing sports with my peers, makes me feel connected and less stressed. However, after a long, exhausting day of exam preparation, I also cherish a few quiet hours alone in my room just to read a comic book or listen to my favorite songs.
